title: How Platform Teams Cut Lead Time in Half
content:
## Why lead time matters

Lead time — from commit to production — is the clearest signal of how fast a team can learn. Teams in the **2024 DORA research** with short lead times also recovered from incidents faster.

## What the three teams changed

1. They published one *paved road* for new services.
2. They moved approvals into automated checks.
3. They measured lead time weekly and shared it.

| Team | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Payments | 9 days | 4 days |
| Search | 6 days | 2 days |

![Deployment dashboard](platform-dashboard.svg "Lead time dashboard")

> Start with one workflow and make it the easiest path.

title: Zero Trust for Small Teams: A 90-Day Plan
content:
Zero trust is a strategy, not a product. Small teams can make real progress in 90 days.

Days 1–30: identity

Turn on phishing-resistant MFA for every account and remove standing admin rights.

Days 31–60: devices

  • Inventory every laptop
  • Require disk encryption

Days 61–90: applications

Put critical applications behind single sign-on.
